verdict.rationale: A secretary of state is a filing office, so a public filing-status lookup is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows a public page on ohiosos.gov or Ohio Business Central for checking the status of a business filing, application, or case. Both SOS hosts returned 403 at robots.txt, so no SOS page content was available to evaluate. The only status feature mentioned is OH|TAX refund status, which belongs to the tax department and is not an SOS filing or case lookup.
